mapper.sql: m.id, m.type, m.biz_type, m.biz_id, m.biz_title, m.std_type, m.type_name, m.wx_msgtype, m.card_action, m.app_id, m.corp_id, m.agent_id, m.task_id, m.dedup_key, m.receiver_oa, m.receiver_wx, m.receiver_count, m.shard_index, m.shard_total, m.status, m.retry_count, m.next_retry_time, m.api_log_id, m.reason, m.src_json, m.operator_id, m.modedatacreatedate, m.modedatacreatetime, m.modedatamodifydatetime
a.cost_ms as api_cost_ms, a.err_code as api_err_code, a.err_msg as api_err_msg, a.req_body as api_req_body, a.resp_body as api_resp_body, a.error_stack as api_err_stack, a.success as api_success

sql.if: and (m.biz_id like '%' + #{bizId} + '%' or m.biz_title like '%' + #{bizId} + '%' or m.task_id like '%' + #{bizId} + '%')

and (m.receiver_oa like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or m.receiver_wx like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or m.reason like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or m.biz_title like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or a.err_msg like '%' + #{keyword} + '%')

mapper.insert:
insert into ${table} (type, biz_type, biz_id, biz_title, std_type, type_name, wx_msgtype, card_action, app_id, corp_id, agent_id, task_id, dedup_key, receiver_oa, receiver_wx, receiver_count, shard_index, shard_total, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, api_log_id, reason, src_json, operator_id, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime, modedatamodifydatetime) values (2, #{e.bizType}, #{e.bizId}, #{e.bizTitle}, #{e.stdType}, #{e.typeName}, #{e.wxMsgtype}, #{e.cardAction}, #{e.appId}, #{e.corpId}, #{e.agentId}, #{e.taskId}, #{e.dedupKey}, #{e.receiverOa}, #{e.receiverWx}, #{e.receiverCount}, #{e.shardIndex}, #{e.shardTotal}, #{e.status}, #{e.retryCount}, #{e.nextRetryTime}, #{e.apiLogId}, #{e.reason}, #{e.srcJson}, #{e.operatorId},
#{e.modedatacreatedate}, #{e.modedatacreatetime}, #{e.modedatamodifydatetime})
mapper.select: select , from ${table} m left join ${apiTable} a on a.id = m.api_log_id where m.id = #{id}

select * from ( select row_number() over (order by m.id desc) as rn, , from ${table} m left join ${apiTable} a on a.id = m.api_log_id
) t where t.rn > #{offset} and t.rn <= #{offset} + #{limit} order by t.rn

select count(1) from ${table} m left join ${apiTable} a on a.id = m.api_log_id
and m.type = 2

select count(1) as totalCount, sum(case when m.status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as successCount, sum(case when m.status = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount, sum(case when m.status = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as dedupCount, sum(case when m.status = 4 then 1 else 0 end) as skipCount, isnull(avg(case when a.cost_ms is not null then a.cost_ms else 0 end), 0) as avgCost from ${table} m left join ${apiTable} a on a.id = m.api_log_id where 1 = 1 and m.type = 2

select isnull(m.type_name, '未命名类型') as typeName, isnull(m.wx_msgtype, '-') as wxMsgtype, count(1) as totalCount, sum(case when m.status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as successCount, sum(case when m.status = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount from ${table} m where m.type = 2 and m.status in (1, 2)
group by m.type_name, m.wx_msgtype order by count(1) desc

select top ${limit} isnull(a.err_msg, '未知错误') as errmsg, count(1) as totalCount from ${table} m left join ${apiTable} a on a.id = m.api_log_id where m.type = 2 and m.status = 2
group by a.err_msg order by count(1) desc
